description: This file defines the CommandResolver enum responsible for resolving and executing OpenClaw commands, managing project paths, handling remote SSH commands, and detecting the environment setup. It contains various static methods to locate executables, resolve runtime paths, handle SSH targets, and build command-line invocation structures.

methods.name: gatewayEntrypoint
methods.description: Determines the main entry point script for the project by checking for specific files in the root directory.

methods.name: runtimeResolution
methods.description: Resolves the RuntimeResolution for the current environment.

methods.name: runtimeResolution(searchPaths:)
methods.description: Resolves the RuntimeResolution with an optional search paths parameter.

methods.name: makeRuntimeCommand
methods.description: Creates a command array to execute a runtime, given the runtime info, entrypoint, subcommand, and extra arguments.

methods.name: runtimeErrorCommand
methods.description: Generates a command array to output an error message related to runtime resolution failure.

methods.name: errorCommand
methods.description: Builds an error output shell script command with a given message.

methods.name: projectRoot
methods.description: Returns the URL of the project root directory, using stored defaults or fallback locations.

methods.name: setProjectRoot
methods.description: Stores the specified project root path into user defaults.

methods.name: projectRootPath
methods.description: Returns the path string of the current project root.

methods.name: preferredPaths
methods.description: Builds a list of preferred executable search paths based on environment and project.

methods.name: findExecutable
methods.description: Searches for an executable by name within provided or default search paths.

methods.name: openclawExecutable
methods.description: Locates the openclaw helper executable within search paths.

methods.name: projectOpenClawExecutable
methods.description: Locates the project-specific openclaw executable if it exists.

methods.name: nodeCliPath
methods.description: Finds the path to the node CLI script file.

methods.name: hasAnyOpenClawInvoker
methods.description: Checks if any known openclaw invoker (CLI, Node, or pnpm) exists in the environment.

methods.name: openclawNodeCommand
methods.description: Constructs the command array to run openclaw via node or remote SSH, handling various environment configurations.

methods.name: openclawCommand
methods.description: Alias for openclawNodeCommand, used to invoke openclaw commands.
